issues.description: StockIngredient constructor signature is inconsistent with the UML/spec. The problem statement (and solution) specify `StockIngredient(String, int, int)`, but the template defines only `StockIngredient(String, int, int, boolean strictValidation)`. This prevents students from instantiating StockIngredient as described (e.g., in SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery) without first modifying the starter API.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the template to include `public StockIngredient(String name, int price, int quantity)` as required by the UML. If the strict-validation variant is desired, keep it as an overload (e.g., add the 3-arg constructor delegating to the 4-arg one with a default boolean).

issues.description: Stock exposes public methods `setStockIngredients(...)` and `getStockIngredients()` in the template/solution, but these methods are not present in the provided UML/spec, which lists only add/take/findStockIngredient/addToStockIngredients/emptyStock. This mismatch can confuse students about the intended Stock API and whether direct array replacement is allowed.
issues.suggestedFix: Either update the UML/spec to include `getStockIngredients()` and `setStockIngredients(...)` as part of the intended public API, or remove `setStockIngredients(...)` from the starter code (and adjust Main/examples accordingly) to keep the API aligned with the diagram.
